# Inneractive
> Inneractive is a mobile advertising platform focused on in-app monetization, mediation, and programmatic demand for app publishers.

Inneractive, now part of Fyber/DT Exchange, provides SDKs, integration guides, ad format documentation, and policy resources for mobile app developers and publishers implementing in-app advertising.

## Documentation
- [Developer Documentation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/): Main documentation hub for SDK integration, ad formats, and platform setup.
- [SDK Documentation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/): Overview of the Inneractive SDK and implementation resources for mobile apps.
- [Android SDK](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/): Android integration documentation for initializing and serving Inneractive ads.
- [iOS SDK](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/): iOS integration documentation for adding Inneractive ads to Apple apps.
- [Mediation Documentation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/): Guides for using Inneractive in mediation and waterfall setups.
- [Ad Formats](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/): Documentation for supported ad units and placement types.

## Android
- [Android SDK Overview](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/): Entry point for Android SDK installation and implementation details.
- [Android Getting Started](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/getting-started/): Initial setup steps, prerequisites, and basic integration flow.
- [Android Banner Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/banner/): Implementation details for banner ad placements on Android.
- [Android Interstitial Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/interstitial/): Guide for loading and showing interstitial ads in Android apps.
- [Android Rewarded Video](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/rewarded-video/): Integration guide for rewarded video ad experiences on Android.
- [Android Native Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/android/native/): Documentation for rendering native ad assets in Android layouts.

## iOS
- [iOS SDK Overview](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/): Entry point for iOS SDK installation and implementation details.
- [iOS Getting Started](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/getting-started/): Initial setup steps, requirements, and app integration workflow.
- [iOS Banner Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/banner/): Guide for integrating banner ad placements in iOS applications.
- [iOS Interstitial Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/interstitial/): Documentation for presenting interstitial ads on iPhone and iPad.
- [iOS Rewarded Video](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/rewarded-video/): Integration instructions for rewarded video ads in iOS apps.
- [iOS Native Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ios/native/): Documentation for displaying native ad assets in custom iOS views.

## Mediation
- [Mediation Overview](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/): Overview of mediation support and partner integration options.
- [AdMob Mediation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/admob/): Instructions for using Inneractive as a mediated network in AdMob.
- [ironSource Mediation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/ironsource/): Setup guide for integrating Inneractive through ironSource mediation.
- [MoPub Mediation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/mopub/): Configuration details for MoPub mediation with Inneractive demand.
- [MAX Mediation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/max/): Guide for integrating Inneractive with AppLovin MAX mediation.
- [Custom Mediation](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/mediation/custom/): General guidance for custom mediation adapter implementations.

## Ad Formats
- [Banner Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/banner/): Overview and implementation notes for banner ad placements.
- [Interstitial Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/interstitial/): Documentation for full-screen interstitial ad experiences.
- [Rewarded Video Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/rewarded-video/): Guide to rewarded ad flows and user reward handling.
- [Native Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/native/): Documentation for native ad rendering and asset usage.
- [MREC Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/mrec/): Information about medium rectangle ad units and placement behavior.
- [Video Ads](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/ad-formats/video/): Details on video-capable ad placements and playback support.

## Platform & Setup
- [Dashboard](https://console.inner-active.mobi/): Publisher console for app setup, placements, reporting, and monetization management.
- [Create an App](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/getting-started/create-an-app/): Steps for registering an app and generating placement identifiers.
- [Placements](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/getting-started/placements/): Guidance on creating and managing ad placements.
- [SDK Initialization](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/getting-started/initialization/): Documentation for initializing the SDK before requesting ads.
- [Test Mode](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/getting-started/test-mode/): Instructions for validating integrations with test ads.
- [Reporting](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/getting-started/reporting/): Overview of reporting access and monetization performance tracking.

## Policies & Compliance
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.inner-active.mobi/privacy-policy/): Company privacy policy covering data collection and processing practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.inner-active.mobi/terms-of-use/): Legal terms governing use of Inneractive services and properties.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.inner-active.mobi/cookie-policy/): Information about cookie usage and consent-related practices.
- [GDPR Information](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/compliance/gdpr/): Guidance for GDPR-related consent handling in SDK integrations.
- [COPPA Compliance](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/compliance/coppa/): Documentation for child-directed treatment and COPPA-related settings.
- [CCPA Compliance](https://developer.inner-active.mobi/sdk/compliance/ccpa/): Guidance for California privacy compliance and user choice signals.
